notes.title: Level editor coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Heya pixels![/h1] 

It's been a while since our last post. But no worries, we are not glitched!
Currently we are working on a [b]huge update[/b] with number one goal BRAND NEW [b]Level editor[/b] with steam [b]workshop[/b] integration so you will be able to create your own levels or play levels made by our awesome community! =)

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/608986557407559719/936072369183805460/LevelEdtiro.gif?width=728&height=410[/img]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/608986557407559719/942141531593265172/updatekLevlEdtiorerk.gif[/img]

So what features will the level editor have?
[olist]
[*]Level Length
[*]Level Speed
[*]Backgrounds
[*]Music
[*]Coins, coins and coins
[*]All enemy types
[*]and more!
[/olist]

In case you would like to stay even more updated, you are always welcome on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jjFNR34EYs]discord community[/url]! ːhappy_creepː

notes.title: Release date delayed
notes.content:
[h1]Heya pixels![/h1]

We are doing our best to create something that was not there before. We have decided to [b]redesign a huge part of the game[/b] and this decision requires more time, so we are both sad and happy to announce the game release date delayed to make the game even better. 

So, what should you expect?
[olist]
[*] Better Design
[*] HQ Textures
[*] New Trailer
[*] Better Effects
[/olist]

[b]When? 20-29. January ~ 2021[/b] ːhappy_creepː
